usdRate.note: Market rate; State Bank of Pakistan site blocked automated access. World Bank 2025 average 281.1

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, Monthly Review on Price Indices, September 2026

inflation_projection.sourceName: State Bank of Pakistan 5-7% target; CPI 10.3% (Sep 2026); 5-year CPI average above 10%
inflation_projection.note: Above the 5-7% target because inflation has missed it in most recent years, but below the 5-year average that includes the 2023 spike.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics (State Bank of Pakistan decision of 26 October 2026)
policy_rate.note: Raised 50 basis points from 11.5%; secondary source because sbp.org.pk blocked automated access

savings_account_rate.note: sbp.org.pk (minimum savings deposit rate rule and deposit rate statistics) blocked automated access; no other current source found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: Searched State Bank of Pakistan deposit rate statistics; site blocked automated access and no other current source found.

fdr_1y_rate.note: Searched State Bank of Pakistan deposit rate statistics; site blocked automated access and no other current source found.

dps_rate.note: No published typical rate for bank recurring deposit schemes found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Latest World Bank value is for 2021 and is outdated; current State Bank of Pakistan figure not reachable

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: National Savings Pakistan, profit rates w.e.f. 21 October 2026
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Regular Income Certificate (5 years, monthly profit); Behbood and Pensioners' Benefit accounts 12.96%; Special Savings Certificates (3 years) 12% to 12.8%

tbill_91d_rate.note: State Bank of Pakistan auction results blocked automated access; secondary sources showed only stale 3-month yields.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Secondary market yield; Trading Economics also shows 12.79%

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Pakistan, Individual income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Final tax 20% on bank deposit interest for individuals with total income up to PKR 5 million; doubled for inactive taxpayers

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: National Savings Pakistan, profit rates w.e.f. 21 October 2026
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: 15% withholding for filers, 30% for non-filers; PwC lists 15% final tax on interest from other sources

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Rs 500,000 per depositor per bank; Deposit Protection Corporation site blocked automated access, so check for a later increase

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate found; State Bank of Pakistan site blocked automated access.

equity_return_low.sourceName: KSE-100 index 166,409 on 2026-10-30 versus about 40,000 ten years earlier; all-time high 191,033 in January 2026
equity_return_low.note: Low case allows for long flat spells like 2017-2020.

equity_return_base.sourceName: KSE-100 10-year record (about 15% a year in price) and after-tax safe rate about 10%
equity_return_base.note: Capped at the after-tax safe rate (about 10%) plus 3 points despite the strong 10-year index record.

equity_return_high.note: High case close to the 10-year price trend.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Dollar gold trend and rupee depreciation
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold with modest rupee depreciation.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Dollar gold trend plus expected rupee depreciation
gold_return_base.note: About 4% dollar gold trend plus about 6% expected rupee depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Dollar gold trend plus faster rupee depreciation
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong gold and faster depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: National Savings short-term certificates 11.12% less 15% tax
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: short-term certificates after tax at lower future rates.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: National Savings Regular Income Certificate 12.12% less 15% tax
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 5-year government savings certificates after filer tax.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case using the senior and pensioner schemes.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Searched for an industry-wide life claim settlement ratio from the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan; none found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is sold in Pakistan but no published premium tables or regulator premium data were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No credible published typical private hospital stay cost found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: PBS health CPI group +7.9% year on year (Sep 2026) with headline 10.3%
goal_inflation_health.note: Medical costs track or exceed headline inflation, so we plan above the 8% general assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: PBS education CPI group +7.8% year on year (Sep 2026)
goal_inflation_education.note: Private school and university fees have risen faster than the 8% general assumption over time.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 (via Our World in Data)
life_table_remaining.note: 2025 estimates; projected = 2050 medium variant; ages 60 and 70 not published in this series

support_ratio.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 old-age dependency ratio (via Our World in Data)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio (7.3 in 2025, 8.5 in 2040, 13.4 in 2065, medium variant)

retirement_age_default.note: Old-age pension at 60 for men, 55 for women, with 15 years of contributions

retirement_age_government.note: Could not reach a primary or secondary page stating the civil servants' superannuation age (Civil Servants Act 1973).

retirement_return_low.sourceName: National Savings short-term certificates after 15% tax
retirement_return_low.note: Low case if savings rates fall toward the inflation target.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: National Savings 1-year short-term certificate 11.72% less 15% tax (9.96%)
retirement_return_base.note: Kept below the after-tax 1-year government savings rate because bill and deposit rates were not reachable.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Behbood and Pensioners' Benefit accounts 12.96% less 15% tax
retirement_return_high.note: High case using the scheme reserved for seniors and pensioners.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Balanced mix of savings certificates and KSE-100 equity
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Balanced mix: half fixed income (10%), half equity (13%)
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Close to the average of the base fixed-income and equity cases, rounded down.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No national non-contributory old-age pension found; the Benazir Income Support Programme is household income support, not an old-age pension.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No national non-contributory old-age pension found.

gratuity_rule.note: 30 days' wages per completed year of service; not paid on dismissal for misconduct

public_pension_scheme.note: EOBI: employer 5% plus employee 1% of minimum wage; pension 2% of average wage per year of contribution after 15 years; minimum Rs 11,500 a month from January 2025; women from 55; raised by government decision, not indexed

dps.note: Some banks offer monthly recurring savings plans

sanchayapatra_5y.note: 5-year certificate with monthly profit; Behbood Savings Certificates for seniors and widows

tbill_91d.note: Individuals can buy through bank investor portfolio securities accounts

equity_fund.note: Open-end equity and index funds regulated by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan

gold.note: Sold mainly as jewellery and tola bars

insuranceRegulator.name: Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan
